maker: University of Manchester (Frederic Williams, Tom Kilburn, Geoff Tootill)
summary: The first computer to run a program held in its own electronic memory, the way every computer has worked since. It was a small test machine, built to try out a new kind of memory, and was soon rebuilt into a larger, practical computer.

events.note: By April 1949 its successor, the Manchester Mark 1, is working.
A working replica built in 1998 is at the Science and Industry Museum in Manchester.

cause: A test machine, developed into the Manchester Mark 1.
